scientific_limitations: The sharp quintic threshold is for local transverse stability of the uniquely optimal first/third-frequency pair. Global support exclusion is proved only for squared radius at most 2/5; global second-harmonic inclusion for squared radius greater than s_c. The exact global onset between these is not determined. Literature-priority risk remains.
title: A sharp local second-harmonic instability threshold for three-band circular Poisson smoothing
